title: Grounded Combat and Courtyard VFX Pass
summary: Presentation-only physical combat, heavier stylised blood, movement and courtyard polish. Resource-based profiles and shared particle budgets.

profile_assignments.melee: data/vfx/melee_<dagger|sword|spear|greatblade|mace|shield>[_charged].tres; referenced by per-weapon light/charged AttackDefinition copies
profile_assignments.movement: data/vfx/player_movement.tres: footstep, sprint, dodge_takeoff, dodge_wake, settle, death
profile_assignments.brazier: data/vfx/brazier_flame.tres, brazier_embers.tres, brazier_smoke.tres via court_prop exports

runtime_connections: World-space tapered melee ribbon sampled from the animated model, respecting active attack phase; charged release dust and hold glint
Independent per-hand ribbons and existing enchanted weapon visuals retained
Sentinel ribbon samples the existing drawn blade endpoints; danger arc dimensions and timing untouched
Accepted damage plus receiver passed to hit_effect; 0.12s secondary-effect limiter and reusable per-receiver confirmation
Directional 32-droplet flesh / 16-droplet armored baseline profiles; capped cosmetic damage scaling
Metal sparks, wood/stone chips and dust; surface blood remains independent of optional attack impact overrides
Blood Off clears sprays and stains; 12-second stain lifetime, final-four-second fade, 64 oldest-first cap
Distinct step/sprint/dodge/wake/settle/death profiles; existing movement/audio event timing retained
Brazier polygon flame + GPU ember/smoke profiles retain persistent light/collision/audio; slow light variation
Dedicated shrine idle/rest visuals; removed duplicate borrowed spell burst, generic shrine burst and extra drawn rest ring
Sparse courtyard ash replaces the older atmosphere emitters/mist; ambient emitter visibility culling
Gameplay-paused particle/trail/expiry clocks and explicit shrine rune shader elapsed time
Actor ownership, weak validity guards, scene-owned lifetimes, shrine cleanup; no physical-effect reparenting during scene teardown

budgets.reduced_effects: Half emitted amount; no smoke or temporary lights; shorter melee/spell trails; unchanged base lighting and essential silhouettes.
budgets.fallback: Secondary decoration can be skipped; lightweight weapon ribbons and per-receiver hit confirmation do not require particle allocations.
budgets.custom_scenes: Pre-existing GPUParticles2D nodes in override scenes are budgeted before instancing into the tree; dynamically created custom emitters should use Feedback.budget_emitter.

compatibility: Original attack assets preserved; 20 presentation copies keep original non-VFX properties and external tuning references.
Weapon definitions retain identity, UIDs, equipped scenes and gameplay metadata; only attack references now select presentation copies.
Existing null-valued charge metadata in sword_light was preserved in its copies rather than changing user-authored timing data.
Feedback.burst remains compatible; available_spell_particles delegates to shared transient accounting.
No spell tuning, AI decisions, damage calculations, hitboxes, movement values, renderer, HUD layout, audio keys, hit-stop or camera-shake strengths changed.
Old VFX resource files remain for compatibility; physical feedback uses the new explicit profiles.
Persistent brazier/shrine lighting remains outside the temporary-light pool, with no new persistent lights.

static_review.diff_check: No whitespace errors; existing Windows line-ending notices only.

runtime_acceptance_pending: Every weapon family and both hands, light/charged attacks, unchanged size/layering and imbue cycling
Accepted versus rejected hits, all five surface categories, repeated hits and impact overrides
Blood toggle immediately removes active sprays/stains and retains non-blood confirmation
Walk/sprint/dodge/idle emission and no movement changes
Danger arc readability during overlapping melee and spells
Shrine rest produces one coordinated sequence and clears transient effects
Shared budget saturation, ambient culling, Reduced Effects toggling and pause
Death, equipment replacement, actor removal and scene reload without stale references/orphans
Visual quality and combined spell/combat/environment GPU performance
